entries.zh: 恆心、堅持不懈；「膠守」謂如膠黏附般固守不捨。
entries.en: constancy, perseverance; to hold fast, to cling to.
entries.notes: L 栏「no alcan camam」疑为原稿残句，R 栏「guiîn diû」与 H「膠守」未能密合，释义主要依 H 与 L 词头。

entries.zh: 星座、星宿（原稿汉字栏空缺，闽南语拼作 guiỹ，对应汉字未定）。
entries.en: constellation (Chinese-character column blank in the original; the Hokkien form is left unassigned).
entries.notes: H、R 两栏皆空，仅存 M 栏拼写 guiỹ 且无汉字可核，词义仅据 L「Constelacion」定。

entries.zh: 亲家：子女婚配双方父母的互称。
entries.en: co-father-in-law; the parents of one's child's spouse (mutual term between the two families).

entries.zh: 敝亲家：谦称自己的亲家。
entries.en: my co-father-in-law (humble form, used of one's own side).

entries.zh: 对头：指结亲的对方一家（闽南语「对头」亦指相对、敌对的一方，此处取「相对的一方」之义）。
entries.en: the opposite party, i.e. the other family in a marriage alliance.
entries.notes: H「對頭」字面可解为敌手，须依 L「Consuegro」与上文亲家条定为姻亲的对方。

entries.en: to consult in secret council; to deliberate privately.

entries.zh: 商议国政；国政、国家政事。
entries.en: to consult on the affairs of the realm; affairs of state.

entries.zh: 公议：公众共同商议、公开议事。
entries.en: public deliberation; common council (matters to be publicly consulted).
entries.notes: L 栏「Consultaderos del pue etc.」为缩写残句，「pue」推为 pueblo（城镇、公众），其余依 H「公議」定。

entries.zh: 相国：辅佐君主的最高大臣（此处谓与相国商议）。
entries.en: chancellor, prime minister (to consult with the chancellor).
entries.notes: L 栏「del m̃abley」疑为缩写或讹写，未能还原，释义依 H「相國」与 R 对音。

entries.zh: 低声议论、窃窃私议（原稿汉字「淡」有疑，或当作「谈」）。
entries.en: to murmur; to discuss in whispers.
entries.notes: 封存件 H 栏自带 [疑:淡/談] 标记，M、R 两栏首音节亦不一致，故降为 medium。

entries.zh: 商议、议论；亦指议论、意见（名词）。

entries.en: to consume, to spend; to suffer loss, to diminish.
to waste, to squander one's estate.

entries.zh: 漏空：钱财如从孔洞漏失；把家产耗费在女人身上。
entries.en: to drain one's estate as through a leak; to squander one's wealth on women.

entries.notes: M 栏第三个拼写「zoap」声调污损难辨（T99），但 H、R 皆作「算」，词义本身可定。
